entities.summary: Sun Yat-sen University is a public university in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Education, and co-funded by the Ministry of Education, SASTIND, and Guangdong Provincial Government. As one of the top universities in China, it is part of Project 211, Project 985, and the Double First-Class Construction.
